draft.subject: Bulk invites and your first project
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks for flagging how slow it is to add people one at a time -- your ticket is still open on our side, and Tariq's answer stands: teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time. Teammates can also be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

On the setup side, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually the quickest way to see it working.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through the CSV format and get your first project set up with you.

Best,
Chidi
